scientific_integrity: Analytical empty-interval proof and publicly reproducible exact generator and Monte Carlo checks; simulations are finite evidence rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: Infinite-line expected vacancy only; positive odd-start rates; no uniform mixing-time bound, finite-size crossover, or independent validation. The full text of Percus (2000) could not be accessed for conclusive coverage analysis.
title: Discontinuous rare-sublattice enhancement of trimer parking on an alternating line
